name: How long does kitchen flooring installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of kitchen flooring installation depends on the material, kitchen size, and subfloor preparation. Simple LVP or laminate installation in a standard kitchen might take 1-2 days. Tile installation, which includes setting time for mortar and grout, typically takes 3-5 days. Hardwood installation can range from 2-4 days, plus additional time for finishing if unfinished wood is used.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen flooring installation generally takes 1-5 days, depending on the material and kitchen size, with tile and hardwood often requiring more time.
